name: read-only-mode
description: --read-only rejects writes at two different levels, distinguished by error code (verified against the upstream spec, not just this repo's testing.md paraphrase). SQL-level writes sent via `exec` are rejected by SQLite's own PRAGMA query_only and surface as sqlite_error. Op-level writes (`overwrite`, `load`) are rejected by the stdio server itself before touching SQLite and surface as read_only. Reads keep working, and the process stays alive through both kinds of rejection.
